revision_reason: Before any P/L run: missing source sessions in 2015/2016 require warmup from 2016-07-12 and evaluation from 2017. DATA_LIMITED Yahoo backward-adjusted OHLC, including Sony spin-off adjustment. Two invalid OHLC envelopes (8306.T/8035.T 2022-05-17) expanded to contain O/C; original and derived values in manifest. No strategy parameter changes.
quality_diagnostics: Aggregate existing sleeves excluding Sony (9 symbols/900000 JPY), and excluding Sony plus 8306.T and 8035.T (7 symbols/700000 JPY). Not new strategy candidates or clean-data claims.
hypothesis: Confirmed daily higher highs and higher lows plus rising SMA21; buy resumption after SMA pullback. Single descriptive adaptation, no original-method equivalence claim.
baseline: Equal initial sleeves buy and hold, same dates and costs, no dividends

entry_rules.trend: last two confirmed highs and lows both rise; close[t]>SMA21[t]>SMA21[t-2]
entry_rules.fill: next observed session open; skip if open<=min(low[t-3:t]); no carry-in signal
entry_rules.warmup: 2016-07-12 onward, SMA21+2 slope bars and two confirmed highs/lows; prior three bars each require valid SMA

exit_rules.stop: min low of 3 bars before signal, excludes signal bar
exit_rules.same_day_reentry: signal at exit day close allowed for next session

final_period_prior_exposure: unknown; descriptive full disclosure, not guaranteed untouched holdout
search_space: One fixed candidate; no parameter search or retuning after results

cost_and_fill_model.cost_basis: price*units each entry/exit, combined commission/slippage assumption
cost_and_fill_model.ohlc: DATA_LIMITED Yahoo backward-adjusted OHLC without adjclose rescaling; Sony spin-off adjustment unresolved; no dividend reinvestment
cost_and_fill_model.gap_priority: open<=SL at open; open>=TP at open; intraday both-hit SL first
cost_and_fill_model.missing_rows: reject invalid rows, duplicates or unsorted data; do not interpolate; next row is next observed session; shared calendars required

position_sizing_and_currency.allocation: all sleeve cash including entry costs; units=cash/(open*(1+cost)); fractional adjusted shares; no leverage/rebalancing; not 100-share-lot execution

cross_symbol_rule: final confirmation net profit positive in at least 6 of 10 symbols
metrics: netJPY PF and win rate, close MTM DD includes initial capital, continuous yearly equity differences, exposure counts any intraday holding day
code_identifier: scripts/research_tamukai_stocks_daily.py; exact SHA256 recorded in result manifest before calculations
